findings.title: The realized-value explanation shows 'Basis: Validated' on a value that is pending Finance validation
findings.reproduction: Demo-initialized stack (e2e/support/with-demo-stack.sh, SYNTHETIC International Roaming dataset) on candidate b506084b (source 98feb869). Sign in as roaming.user.to and open the benefit page /transformations/<the roaming transformation>/benefits/01995000-4401-7000-8000-000000000001 (the synthetic 'Revenue uplift' benefit). Then open 'Show the explanation of the realized value': the E2 panel, apps/web/src/components/explanation/panels.tsx BenefitRealizedExplanation. Probe: docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/domain/round-1/probes/zz-domain-demo-probe.spec.ts, run in chromium-en and chromium-ar.
findings.expected: A plain-language explanation of the realized value (REQ-S15-014 clause 1) keeps pending and validated values clearly apart (Finance validation; 'forecast is never validated value'). A row under 'Pending Finance validation (not realized)' should not carry the bare word 'Validated'. Alternatively the column should say what is validated, for example 'Comparison basis: validated by Finance'.
findings.actual: In the 'Pending Finance validation (not realized)' table, the row '1 Aug 2026 to 31 Aug 2026 | SAR 99,000.00' shows Basis 'Validated' (ar: column 'الأساس', value 'معتمد'). The column holds the line's comparison basis: the baseline and formula version, validated or provisional (openapi listBenefitMeasurements: 'basis (validated or provisional)'), not the state of the value. The label 'Basis' does not say this, so a business reader sees 'Validated' on a value that the same panel says is not realized. Totals and states are correct: the pending SAR 99,000.00 is not added to the realized SAR 222,750.00. Only the wording is wrong; no value, total or state is.

history.note: Raised by domain-reviewer in DG6 clean re-gate round 1 (T-DG6-REV-DOM-RG-R1). Low, non-mandatory: a wording defect in a plain-language explanation; no calculation is affected.
